alarms.title: Dry run: path leaves the seam at the end
alarms.operator_title: Dry run: path leaves the seam
alarms.operator_message: In the dry run, the torch left the seam near the end.
alarms.technical_detail: The seam-scan correction was applied to the start point only; the end waypoints kept their nominal positions, so the torch path drifts 2.6 mm from the measured seam over the last 80 mm.

ground_truth.root_cause: Correction offset applied to the start waypoint only, not to the whole path (simulated program error).
ground_truth.consequence_if_ignored: Weld misses the joint at the seam end (lack of fusion).

expected_response.resolved_when: Dry run deviation stays under 0.5 mm along the whole seam.

hints: The path was fixed at the start but not at the end.
Compare the blue measured seam with the orange torch path in the 3D view.
Choose 'Apply correction to whole seam', then run the dry run again.

alarms.literature: Seam finding and path correction before welding: Curiel et al. 2023; Li et al. 2026.
resolution_script: Open the 3D view. Compare the blue seam with the orange path.
The path must stay within 0.5 mm along the whole seam.
When the dry run is green, press 'Problem solved'.

alarms.title: Dry run: torch too close to holding robot B
alarms.operator_title: Dry run: torch close to holding robot

signals.name: Distance torch - gripper B at waypoint 7

alarms.operator_message: The torch came very close to robot B's gripper. The dry run stopped.
alarms.technical_detail: At waypoint 7 the torch nozzle passes 8 mm from holding robot B's gripper; the minimum clearance is 20 mm. The approach angle at the corner is too flat for the current gripper pose.

ground_truth.root_cause: Approach waypoint 7 programmed with too flat a torch angle for this part variant (simulated).
ground_truth.consequence_if_ignored: Collision between torch and gripper; damaged torch, lost part.

expected_response.resolved_when: Dry run completes with all clearances at least 20 mm.

hints: The robots would hit each other at one corner. Keep them stopped.
Open waypoint 7 in the 3D view and look at the torch angle at the corner.
Tilt the torch more at waypoint 7 (or let robot B hold the part higher), then repeat the dry run.

alarms.literature: Workspace and multi-robot coordination issues in robotic welding cells: Li et al. 2026; Marvel et al. 2020 (robot-world representation).
resolution_script: Raise the torch angle at waypoint 7 by 10 degrees.
Or: set robot B's holding pose to 'High' for this part.
Run the dry run again. All distances must be 20 mm or more.
When the dry run is green, press 'Problem solved'.

alarms.title: Wrong program for this part
alarms.operator_title: Program does not match the part
alarms.operator_message: The robot program is for a different part. The path ends 40 mm too early.
alarms.technical_detail: Loaded program BRACKET-A (seam 180 mm) does not match the scanned part BRACKET-B (seam 220 mm). The dry-run path stops 40 mm before the seam end.

ground_truth.root_cause: Job created with the program of a similar part variant (simulated).

expected_response.resolved_when: Program BRACKET-B loaded and dry run passes.

hints: The robot thinks this is a different part.
Compare the part name on the label with the program name on the screen.
Open 'Change program', choose BRACKET-B, then run the dry run again.

alarms.literature: Program reuse and editing as cobot interface needs: Frijns & Schmidbauer 2021 (guidelines 12, 18).
resolution_script: Do not weld: the program is for another part.
Read the part label: it says BRACKET-B.
Run the dry run again. Check that the path ends at the seam end.
When the dry run is green, press 'Problem solved'.
